source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 21 (PDF 169-186), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 21 (Space and Environment) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is meant by space and by environment in this chapter?
(Is chapter mein space aur environment se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Space Earth ke atmosphere se aage ka ilaqa hai jahan planets, stars aur galaxies gravity aur electromagnetic radiations se aapas mein amal karte hain. Environment (mahol) woh physical, chemical aur biological ird-gird ke halaat (hawa, paani, zameen, climate, ecosystems) hain jin mein jaandaar aur bejaan nizaam maujood hain.

book_ref.quote: Space refers to a region beyond Earth's atmosphere in which all celestial bodies

blocks.prompt:
2 On which two factors does the luminosity of a star mainly depend? Explain each briefly.
(Star ki luminosity zyada tar kin do cheezon par munhasir hai? Har aik ki mukhtasar wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Radius: bare star ke paas radiation kharij karne ke liye zyada surface area hai, is liye woh zyada luminous hai. (2) Surface temperature: barabar size ke do stars mein zyada garam star zyada energy kharij karta hai aur zyada luminous hai.

book_ref.quote: Luminosity of a star primarily depends on its radius and surface temperature

blocks.prompt:
3 Why is luminosity called the intrinsic brightness of a star? Give its symbol and unit.
(Luminosity ko star ki intrinsic (asal) chamak kyun kaha jata hai? Is ki alamat aur unit batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Luminosity woh kul power hai jo star khud electromagnetic radiation ki shakal mein kharij karta hai; yeh dekhne wale ki jagah par munhasir nahi, is liye star ki asal chamak hai. Alamat: L; unit: watt (W).

book_ref.quote: It is a fundamental property that defines the intrinsic brightness of a star

blocks.prompt:
4 Write the Stefan-Boltzmann law in the form used for a star and name each symbol.
(Star ke liye Stefan-Boltzmann law ki equation likhein aur har alamat ka naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: L = 4πr²σT⁴ (luminosity = surface area 4πr² × radiant intensity σT⁴). L = luminosity (W), r = star ka radius (m), T = surface temperature (K), σ = Stefan-Boltzmann constant = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴.

book_ref.quote: The luminosity of a star can be represented as the product of its surface area (A=4πr²) and radiant intensity (I = σT⁴)

blocks.prompt:
5 Show that the unit of the Stefan-Boltzmann constant is W m⁻² K⁻⁴.
(Sabit karein ke Stefan-Boltzmann constant ki unit W m⁻² K⁻⁴ hai.)
blocks.explanation: L = 4πr²σT⁴ se σ = L/(4πr²T⁴). σ ki unit = W/(m² × K⁴) = W m⁻² K⁻⁴.

book_ref.quote: Its value is 5.67×10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴

blocks.prompt:
6 The surface temperature of a star rises from 4000 K to 8000 K with no change in radius. By what factor does its luminosity change?
(Star ka surface temperature 4000 K se 8000 K ho jata hai aur radius wohi rehta hai. Luminosity kitne guna badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fixed r par L ∝ T⁴. L₂/L₁ = (8000/4000)⁴ = 2⁴ = 16. Luminosity 16 guna ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: If a star becomes twice as hot, how many times more energy will it radiate?

blocks.prompt:
7 A star has radius 3.0 × 10⁸ m and surface temperature 4000 K. Find its luminosity (σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴).
(Aik star ka radius 3.0 × 10⁸ m aur surface temperature 4000 K hai. Us ki luminosity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Stefan-Boltzmann's law helps astronomers estimate the size and brightness of stars

blocks.prompt:
8 What is the luminosity of the Sun, and what does this value show?
(Suraj ki luminosity kitni hai aur yeh qeemat kya zahir karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Suraj ki luminosity taqreeban 4 × 10²⁶ W hai. Yeh itni bari power hai jaise har second arbon nuclear dhamake ho rahe hon.

book_ref.quote: The Sun shines with an immense luminosity of about 4×10²⁶ watts

blocks.prompt:
9 Define radiant flux intensity and write its SI unit.
(Radiant flux intensity ki definition likhein aur SI unit batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Radiant flux intensity star se Earth ki surface tak fi unit area fi unit waqt pohanchne wali electromagnetic energy hai, yani fi unit area luminosity: F = L/4πr². SI unit: W m⁻².

book_ref.quote: radiant flux intensity is the luminosity per unit area measured on the surface of Earth

blocks.prompt:
10 Differentiate between luminosity and radiant flux intensity.
(Luminosity aur radiant flux intensity mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Luminosity star ki kul power hai; radiant flux intensity kisi faasle par fi unit area milne wali power hai.

book_ref.quote: It is a small fraction of the total value of luminosity

rows: Star se fi unit waqt kharij kul energy.
Earth tak fi unit area fi unit waqt pohanchne wali energy.
Asal (intrinsic): faasle par munhasir nahi.
Faasle ke saath 1/r² ke hisaab se kam hoti hai.
L = 4πr²σT⁴ (r = star ka radius).
F = L/4πr² (r = star se faasla).
Unit: W.
Unit: W m⁻².

blocks.prompt:
11 In F = L/4πr², what does 4πr² represent?
(F = L/4πr² mein 4πr² kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 4πr² us farzi sphere (kurra) ka area hai jis ka radius r (star se naapne ki jagah tak faasla) hai aur jis par star ki luminosity phailti hai. Yeh star ki apni surface ka area nahi.

book_ref.quote: In F = L/4πr², r is the distance from the star to the place where the flux is measured

blocks.prompt:
12 Why does the radiant flux intensity of a star follow the inverse square law?
(Star ki radiant flux intensity inverse square law par kyun chalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Star ki luminosity L constant rehti hai aur 4πr² area ke sphere par phailti hai. Is liye F = L/4πr² ∝ 1/r²: faasla dugna karne se flux aik chauthai reh jati hai.

book_ref.quote: radiant flux intensity follows inverse square law with distance

blocks.prompt:
13 A star of luminosity 4.0 × 10²⁶ W is 1.5 × 10¹¹ m from a planet. Find the radiant flux intensity at the planet.
(4.0 × 10²⁶ W luminosity wala star aik planet se 1.5 × 10¹¹ m door hai. Planet par radiant flux intensity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Radiant flux intensity from a star at a distance d is expressed as:

blocks.prompt:
14 The radiant flux from a star at a planet 1.6 × 10¹¹ m away is 1200 W m⁻². Find the luminosity of the star.
(1.6 × 10¹¹ m door planet par star ki radiant flux 1200 W m⁻² hai. Star ki luminosity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: where L is the luminosity and 4πr² is the surface area of star

blocks.prompt:
15 The radiant flux from a star at distance r is 900 W m⁻². What is it at distance 3r?
(Faasle r par star ki radiant flux 900 W m⁻² hai. Faasle 3r par kitni hogi?)

book_ref.quote: increasing the distance to three times its initial length (3r), decreases the flux by a factor of nine

blocks.prompt:
16 Two stars give equal radiant flux at the Earth, but one is 4 times farther away. Which is more luminous and by how much?
(Do stars Earth par barabar radiant flux dete hain lekin aik 4 guna door hai. Kaun sa zyada luminous hai aur kitna?)
blocks.explanation: Dono ke liye F = L/4πr² barabar hai, is liye L ∝ r². Door wala star 4² = 16 guna zyada luminous hai.

book_ref.quote: Two stars appear equally bright in the night sky. However, one is 10 times farther away than the other.

blocks.prompt:
17 What property must an object have to serve as a standard candle? Name two such objects.
(Kisi jism mein standard candle banne ke liye kaun si khasiyat honi chahiye? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Us ki intrinsic (asal) chamak yani luminosity maloom ya pehle se andaze ke qabil (predictable) honi chahiye. Misalein: Cepheid variable stars aur Type Ia supernovae.

book_ref.quote: The standard candles are astronomical objects with known intrinsic brightness

blocks.prompt:
18 Which law of light is used with a standard candle to find its distance, and what two quantities are compared?
(Standard candle ka faasla nikalne ke liye light ka kaun sa qanoon istemal hota hai aur kin do cheezon ka muqabla hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Light ka inverse-square law (F = L/4πd²). Earth se zahiri chamak (apparent magnitude / naapi gayi flux) ka maloom asal chamak (luminosity) se muqabla hota hai; phir d = √(L/4πF).

book_ref.quote: astronomers can calculate its distance using the inverse-square law of light

blocks.prompt:
19 A Cepheid of luminosity 1.0 × 10³⁰ W gives a flux of 2.0 × 10⁻¹⁰ W m⁻² at Earth. Find its distance.
(1.0 × 10³⁰ W luminosity wala Cepheid Earth par 2.0 × 10⁻¹⁰ W m⁻² flux deta hai. Us ka faasla nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: measuring the distances to stars and galaxies is essential for understanding the structure and expansion of the universe

blocks.prompt:
20 Differentiate between the intrinsic brightness and the apparent brightness of a star.
(Star ki intrinsic chamak aur apparent (zahiri) chamak mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Intrinsic chamak star ki asal chamak hai; apparent chamak woh hai jo Earth se nazar aati hai.

book_ref.quote: By comparing how bright a standard candle appears from the Earth (apparent magnitude)

rows: Star asal mein kitna chamakdar hai (luminosity).
Earth se star kitna chamakdar nazar aata hai (apparent magnitude).
Faasle par munhasir nahi.
Faasle ke saath kam hoti hai (inverse-square law).
Standard candle ke liye pehle se maloom.
Earth se naapi jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
21 Why are stars treated as blackbody radiators?
(Stars ko blackbody radiators kyun samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stars nuclear fusion se apni energy banate hain aur use bohat si wavelengths par electromagnetic radiation ki shakal mein kharij karte hain jo baghair khala ka continuous spectrum banati hai. Yeh spectrum blackbody spectrum jaisa hai.

book_ref.quote: Stars such as Sun behave like blackbody radiator

blocks.prompt:
22 How can the surface temperature of a star be found from its spectrum?
(Star ke spectrum se us ka surface temperature kaise maloom kiya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har star ka apna continuous spectrum hai. Spectrum se maximum intensity ki wavelength λmax parhi jati hai aur Wien ka qanoon T = b/λmax surface temperature deta hai.

book_ref.quote: As each star has its own spectrum, so its surface temperature is also different.

blocks.prompt:
23 Write Wien's displacement law in mathematical form and give the value and unit of Wien's constant.
(Wien's displacement law ki riyazi shakal likhein aur Wien constant ki qeemat aur unit batayein.)
blocks.explanation: λmax ∝ 1/T, yani λmax T = b, jahan λmax maximum intensity ki wavelength aur T surface temperature hai. b = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K.

book_ref.quote: The wavelength corresponding to the radiation of maximum intensity emitted by a blackbody is inversely proportional to its surface temperature

blocks.prompt:
24 Why does a heated object change colour as its temperature rises?
(Garam jism ka rang temperature barhne se kyun badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Wien ke qanoon λmax T = b se T barhne par λmax chhoti wavelengths ki taraf khisakti hai. Is liye halka surkh chamakta jism (lambi λ) peela aur phir safaid ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: This shift explains the change in colour of heated objects

blocks.prompt:
25 Differentiate between a hot (blue) star and a cool (red) star on the basis of Wien's law.
(Wien ke qanoon ki buniyad par garam (neele) aur thande (surkh) star mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Garam star ki peak wavelength chhoti (neeli/banafshi) aur thande star ki lambi (surkh/infrared) hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: hotter objects emit radiation with shorter wavelengths (appearing blue or violet)

rows: Zyada surface temperature.
Kam surface temperature.
Chhoti λmax.
Lambi λmax.
Neela ya banafshi nazar aata hai.
Surkh nazar aata hai (ya zyada infrared deta hai).

blocks.prompt:
26 The peak wavelength of a star is 725 nm. Find its surface temperature (b = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K).
(Aik star ki peak wavelength 725 nm hai. Us ka surface temperature nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Wien's Displacement law describes the relationship between the surface temperature T of a blackbody

blocks.prompt:
27 Find the peak wavelength of radiation from a body at 2900 K (b = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K). In which region does it lie?
(2900 K par jism ki radiation ki peak wavelength nikalein. Yeh kis hisse mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: λmax = b/T = 2.9 × 10⁻³ / 2900 = 1.0 × 10⁻⁶ m = 1000 nm. Yeh surkh light se lambi hai, yani infrared mein.

book_ref.quote: If a star's peak wavelength is shorter, what does that tell us about its temperature?

blocks.prompt:
28 What is an ideal blackbody, and why do scientists need this idea?
(Ideal blackbody kya hai aur scientists ko is tasawwur ki zaroorat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Blackbody apne upar girne wali tamam radiation jazb karta hai aur har wavelength par mukammal radiation kharij karta hai. Haqeeqi ajsaam aisa poori tarah nahi karte, is liye radiation ke durust mutale ke liye ideal blackbody ka tasawwur istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: A blackbody is one that absorbs all the radiations falling on it and also emits radiations at all wavelengths perfectly

blocks.prompt:
29 Why does a hollow cavity with a small hole act as a nearly perfect blackbody?
(Chhote surakh wala khokhla cavity taqreeban mukammal blackbody kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ki andaruni deewaron par kaali carbon soot lagi hoti hai. Surakh se dakhil radiation andar takra takra kar phans jati hai, is liye taqreeban sab jazb ho jati hai. Garam karne par cavity tamam wavelengths ki radiation kharij karti hai.

book_ref.quote: a good example of a blackbody is a hollow cavity with a small hole and blackened inner walls

blocks.prompt:
30 State two features of blackbody radiation curves as the temperature increases.
(Temperature barhne par blackbody radiation curves ki do khasiyat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Kharij energy barhti hai (curve ooncha hota hai). (2) Curve ki peak chhoti wavelengths ki taraf khisakti hai, yani zyada garam blackbody chhoti wavelengths par zyada energy deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The pattern of this radiation depends only on the temperature of the blackbody

blocks.prompt:
31 Give one example of radiation with an almost perfect blackbody spectrum, and explain why we can be seen in the dark with thermal cameras.
(Taqreeban mukammal blackbody spectrum wali radiation ki aik misal dein, aur batayein ke thermal cameras andhere mein hamein kaise dekh lete hain.)
blocks.explanation: Cosmic microwave background radiation ka spectrum taqreeban mukammal blackbody hai. Hamara jism bhi infrared hisse mein blackbody radiation deta hai jise night-vision (thermal infrared) cameras andhere mein pakar lete hain.

book_ref.quote: It is the cosmic microwave background radiation that has an almost perfect blackbody spectrum

blocks.prompt:
32 Write the formula for the radius of a star in terms of its luminosity and peak wavelength.
(Star ke radius ka formula us ki luminosity aur peak wavelength ki shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Wien ke qanoon se T = b/λmax. L = 4πr²σT⁴ se: r = √(L/4πσT⁴) = √[L/(4πσ(b/λmax)⁴)] = (λmax²/b²)√(L/4πσ).

book_ref.quote: then Stefan-Boltzmann law is used to determine the radius of star

blocks.prompt:
33 How is the luminosity of a distant star found before calculating its radius?
(Door star ka radius nikalne se pehle us ki luminosity kaise maloom ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Earth par radiant flux intensity F naapi jati hai aur star ka faasla d maloom hota hai; phir L = 4πd²F.

book_ref.quote: The Luminosity of a star can be calculated using the radiant flux intensity

blocks.prompt:
34 A star has λmax = 500 nm and luminosity 2.0 × 10²⁷ W. Find its surface temperature first, then state the law used next to get its radius.
(Aik star ki λmax = 500 nm aur luminosity 2.0 × 10²⁷ W hai. Pehle surface temperature nikalein, phir batayein ke radius ke liye agla kaun sa qanoon lagega.)
blocks.explanation: T = b/λmax = 2.9 × 10⁻³ / 500 × 10⁻⁹ = 5800 K. Phir Stefan-Boltzmann law L = 4πr²σT⁴ se r = √(L/4πσT⁴) = 1.6 × 10⁹ m.

book_ref.quote: the surface temperature T of a star is first determined using Wien's displacement law

blocks.text: 21.6 Emission and Absorption Spectra from Different Stars

blocks.prompt:
35 How are dark lines formed in the spectrum of a star?
(Star ke spectrum mein kaali lines kaise banti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Garam ghani surface continuous spectrum deti hai. Yeh light thande bairooni atmosphere se guzarti hai to atoms energy levels ke darmiyan electronic transitions ke mutabiq khaas wavelengths jazb kar lete hain aur kaali lines reh jati hain: yeh absorption spectrum hai.

book_ref.quote: atoms in the gaseous layers absorb specific wavelengths corresponding to electronic transitions between energy levels

blocks.prompt:
36 The absorbed energy is re-emitted at the same wavelengths. Why, then, do the dark lines not disappear?
(Jazb shuda energy usi wavelength par dobara kharij hoti hai. Phir kaali lines ghayab kyun nahi hotin?)
blocks.explanation: Dobara kharij photons mukhtalif simton mein bikhar jate hain, is liye bohat kam Earth ki taraf aate hain. Is liye hamein milne wali light mein yeh wavelengths ghayab rehti hain.

book_ref.quote: the emitted photons are scattered in various directions making them unlikely to reach observers on Earth

blocks.prompt:
37 What is redshift of spectral lines, and why does it occur?
(Spectral lines ka redshift kya hai aur kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Door stars aur galaxies ke spectra mein lines laboratory qeemat se lambi wavelengths par nazar aati hain; yeh redshift hai. Yeh phailti kaainat mein safar karte photons ke khinchne se hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This phenomenon is called redshift which occurs due to stretching of photons

blocks.text: 21.7 Cosmic Redshift: Evidence for an Expanding Universe

blocks.prompt:
38 Differentiate between redshift and blue shift.
(Redshift aur blue shift mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Redshift: Δλ musbat, source door ja raha hai; blue shift: Δλ manfi, source qareeb aa raha hai.

book_ref.quote: When the observed change in wavelength Δλ is positive, it indicates a redshift (Z)

rows: Naapi gayi wavelength barhti hai (Δλ musbat).
Naapi gayi wavelength ghatti hai (Δλ manfi).
Lines surkh sire ki taraf jati hain.
Lines neele sire ki taraf jati hain.
Source Earth se door ja raha hai.
Source Earth ki taraf aa raha hai.

blocks.prompt:
39 Write the redshift formula and explain why Z has no unit.
(Redshift ka formula likhein aur batayein ke Z ki unit kyun nahi.)
blocks.explanation: Z = Δλ/λ ≈ Δf/f ≈ v/c (jab v, c se bohat kam ho). Har aik do aik jaisi quantities ka ratio hai (wavelength/wavelength, speed/speed), is liye Z be-unit number hai.

book_ref.quote: Z = Δλ/λ ≈ Δf/f ≈ v/c (for speeds much less than c)

blocks.prompt:
40 A line of laboratory wavelength 434 nm is observed at 451.4 nm in a galaxy's spectrum. Find Z and the recession speed (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹).
(434 nm laboratory wavelength wali line galaxy ke spectrum mein 451.4 nm par nazar aati hai. Z aur recession speed nikalein (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹).)

book_ref.quote: The observed change in the wavelength of light is directly related to the relative velocity between the source and the observer

blocks.prompt:
41 Why does the light from faraway galaxies appear more red than expected?
(Door galaxies ki light tawaqqo se zyada surkh kyun nazar aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kaainat phailne se space khud khinch rahi hai. Is se raaste mein light ki lehrein khinch kar lambi (zyada surkh) wavelength wali ho jati hain. Galaxies sirf space mein harkat nahi kar rahin; un ke darmiyan space barh rahi hai.

book_ref.quote: rather, the space between them is increasing

blocks.prompt:
42 What does the Big Bang theory suggest, and how does redshift support it?
(Big Bang theory kya kehti hai aur redshift is ki taeed kaise karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh kehti hai ke kaainat aik intehai garam aur ghani halat se shuru hui aur tab se barh rahi hai. Har simt mein nazar aane wala redshift kaainat ka phailao dikhata hai jo is khayal ki taeed karta hai.

book_ref.quote: These findings strongly support the Big Bang theory

blocks.prompt:
43 What is satellite remote sensing? Give two uses.
(Satellite remote sensing kya hai? Do istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh aisi technology hai jo gardish karte spacecraft par lage sensors se space se Earth ke mahol ki nigrani aur tajziya karti hai. Istemal: jangal ki katai aur climate change ka pata; samandar ke temperature aur atmosphere ki banawat ki nigrani.

book_ref.quote: uses sensors aboard orbiting spacecraft to monitor and analyze Earth's environment from space

blocks.prompt:
44 Give two advantages of satellite remote sensing over ground-based methods.
(Zameeni tareeqon ke muqable mein satellite remote sensing ke do fawaid batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Yeh wasee jughrafiyai ihata deti hai. (2) Waqt ke saath baar baar mushahida deti hai, jis se taweel muddati nigrani mumkin hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: it offers wide geographic coverage and repeated observations over time

blocks.prompt:
45 List, in order, the steps of satellite remote sensing.
(Satellite remote sensing ke qadam tarteeb se likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Source aur illumination, (2) atmosphere, (3) target se amal, (4) sensor se recording, (5) transmission aur reception, (6) interpretation aur analysis.

book_ref.quote: The first and foremost element of SRS is source or illumination

blocks.prompt:
46 Why is the method called 'remote' sensing, and what happens at the reception station?
(Is tareeqe ko 'remote' sensing kyun kehte hain aur reception station par kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kharij ya reflect shuda radiation record karne wale sensors remote hain, yani target se rabte mein nahi. Recorded data reception station bheja jata hai jahan use samajh mein aane wali shakal, maslan images, mein badla jata hai.

book_ref.quote: recorded by sensors which are remote (not in contact with target)

blocks.prompt:
47 Write Hubble's law in equation form and give the value and unit of Hubble's constant.
(Hubble's law ki equation likhein aur Hubble constant ki qeemat aur unit batayein.)
blocks.explanation: v = H₀d, jahan v galaxy ki recession velocity aur d faasla hai. H₀ = 2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹ (unit: (m s⁻¹)/m = s⁻¹).

book_ref.quote: Hₒ is called Hubble's constant and its value is 2.3×10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
48 What does the graph of recession velocity against distance of galaxies show?
(Galaxies ki recession velocity aur faasle ka graph kya dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh seedhi line hai: velocity faasle ke saath linear barhti hai, jo phailti kaainat ki mazboot daleel hai. Is ki slope Hubble constant H₀ hai.

book_ref.quote: The slope of this linear trend corresponds to the Hubble constant (H₀)

blocks.prompt:
49 A galaxy is 4.0 × 10²³ m away. Find its recession velocity (H₀ = 2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹).
(Aik galaxy 4.0 × 10²³ m door hai. Us ki recession velocity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: the farther a galaxy is, the faster it appears to be moving away

blocks.prompt:
50 Explain the inflated-balloon model of the expanding universe.
(Phailti kaainat ka inflated-balloon model samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Balloon par nuqte galaxies aur balloon ki jild space-time hai. Balloon phulane par har nuqta baqi sab nuqton ko door jata dekhta hai. Isi tarah har galaxy doosri galaxies ko door jata dekhti hai: phailao har jagah hai aur koi khaas markaz nahi.

book_ref.quote: The dots which are marked on the surface of a balloon represent the galaxies

blocks.prompt:
51 Does the recession of all galaxies from us mean that the Earth is at the centre of the universe? Explain.
(Kya tamam galaxies ka hum se door jana yeh matlab hai ke Earth kaainat ke markaz mein hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Kisi bhi doosri galaxy ka observer bhi sab galaxies ko door jata dekhega kyunke space khud khinch rahi hai. Phailao har jagah hai aur koi khaas markaz nahi, is liye Earth markaz mein nahi.

book_ref.quote: Earth is not at the centre of the universe

blocks.prompt:
52 What do we learn by conceptually reversing the expansion of the universe in time?
(Kaainat ke phailao ko khayali tor par waqt mein ulta chalane se kya seekhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Maazi mein galaxies aik doosre ke qareeb thin; aur peeche jayen to tamam maadda bohat chhoti, ghani aur garam halat mein simta hua tha. Yahi Big Bang theory ki buniyad hai (taqreeban 13.8 billion saal pehle aaghaz).

book_ref.quote: in the past, galaxies were closer together

blocks.prompt:
53 What is meant by Earth's climate system, and why is it important to understand it?
(Earth ke climate system se kya muraad hai aur ise samajhna kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh kisi ilaqe mein temperature, barish, hawa aur mausam ka taweel muddati pattern hai. Ise samajhne se hum climate change ke asraat ke liye tayyari aur un mein kami kar sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: Earth's climate system is a long-term pattern of temperature, rainfall, wind, and other weather conditions in a region

blocks.prompt:
54 Name the natural factors and the human activities that shape Earth's climate.
(Earth ke climate ko banane wale qudrati awamil aur insani sargarmiyan batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Qudrati awamil: Suraj aur ocean currents. Insani sargarmiyan: fossil fuels jalana aur jangal kaatna.

book_ref.quote: The climate is shaped by natural factors, like the Sun and ocean currents

blocks.prompt:
55 What are the cryosphere and the lithosphere? How are the components of the climate system linked?
(Cryosphere aur lithosphere kya hain? Climate system ke components aapas mein kaise jure hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cryosphere: barf aur permafrost. Lithosphere: Earth ki oopri chattani teh. Components mil kar kaam karte aur aik doosre par asar dalte hain, is liye aik hisse ki tabdeeli doosron mein tabdeeli la sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: Changes in one part can cause changes in the others

blocks.prompt:
56 Differentiate between surface currents and thermohaline circulation.
(Surface currents aur thermohaline circulation mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Surface currents oopri teh mein hawa se chalne wale bahao hain; thermohaline circulation gehri tahon ke darmiyan density se chalne wali amoodi gardish hai.

book_ref.quote: The seawater circulates in two main ways: i.e., across the surface and between the deeper layers.

rows: Samandar ki oopri teh par bahao.
Surface aur gehri tahon ke darmiyan amoodi gardish.
Zyada tar hawa se.
Temperature aur salinity (density) ke farq se.
Earth ki gardish se gyres ki shakal.
Ahista global conveyor belt ki tarah.

blocks.prompt:
57 What are gyres? In which direction do they spin in each hemisphere?
(Gyres kya hain? Har hemisphere mein kis rukh ghoomte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gyres Earth ki gardish se banne wale bare gol samandari current nizaam hain. Yeh northern hemisphere mein clockwise aur southern hemisphere mein anticlockwise ghoomte hain.

book_ref.quote: These spin clockwise in the northern hemisphere and anticlockwise in the southern hemisphere

blocks.prompt:
58 How are wind belts formed on the Earth? Name them.
(Earth par hawa ki belts kaise banti hain? Un ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Earth ki surface ke ghair-yaksaan garam hone se garam hawa uthti aur thandi hawa us ki jagah aati hai. Is se belts banti hain: trade winds, westerlies aur polar easterlies.

book_ref.quote: Wind patterns are created due to an uneven heating of the Earth's surface

blocks.prompt:
59 How do wind patterns and ocean currents together affect the climate?
(Hawa ke patterns aur ocean currents mil kar climate par kya asar dalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hawa surface ka paani hilati aur currents ki simt aur taqat par asar dalti hai; currents garam paani poles ki taraf aur thanda wapas lati hain. Mil kar yeh heat aur energy poore planet par phailate hain aur climate zones aur mausam par asar dalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Together, wind patterns and ocean currents help distribute heat and energy across the planet

blocks.text: 21.11 Global Climate and Energy Transfer from the Sun

blocks.prompt:
60 What is Earth's energy budget? What happens when it is balanced?
(Earth ka energy budget kya hai? Is ke mutawazin hone par kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh Earth ki jazb shuda solar energy aur space mein wapas (infrared radiation ki shakal mein) kharij energy ka tawazun hai. Tawazun qaim rahe to Earth ka temperature waqt ke saath constant rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: The Earth's energy budget refers to the balance between the solar energy absorbed by the Earth and the energy it radiates back into space

blocks.prompt:
61 Differentiate between the effect of ice/snow cover and dark surfaces (land, ocean) on the Earth's temperature.
(Earth ke temperature par barf ki teh aur gehri surfaces (zameen, samandar) ke asar mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Barf dhoop reflect kar ke Earth ko thanda karti hai; gehri surfaces dhoop jazb kar ke garam karti hain.

book_ref.quote: Ice and snow are bright and reflect a large amount of sunlight back into space

rows: Chamakdar surfaces.
Gehri (dark) surfaces.
Bohat si dhoop space mein wapas reflect karti hain.
Zyada dhoop jazb aur kam reflect karti hain.
Thandi Earth ko aur thanda karti hain.
Garam hoti Earth ko aur garam karti hain.

blocks.prompt:
62 How do greenhouse gases cause global warming?
(Greenhouse gases global warming kaise paida karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Earth infrared radiation ki shakal mein energy kho deti hai. Greenhouse gases yeh infrared radiation phansa kar space mein jane nahi detin, is liye jane wali energy aane wali se kam hoti hai aur Earth garam hoti hai: global warming.

book_ref.quote: greenhouse gases trap infrared radiations, preventing it from escaping into space

blocks.prompt:
63 What fraction of the Sun's energy does the Earth absorb, and why is a small imbalance important?
(Earth Suraj ki energy ka kitna hissa jazb karti hai aur chhota sa adm-e-tawazun kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Earth Suraj ki energy ka taqreeban 70% jazb karti hai; baqi badal, barf aur sehra reflect kar dete hain. Is budget mein sirf 1% adm-e-tawazun bhi global temperature mein bari tabdeeli la sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: A 1% imbalance in this budget can lead to major global temperature shifts

blocks.prompt:
64 Differentiate between the heating at the equator and at the poles.
(Equator aur poles ki garmi mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Equator par seedhi tez dhoop aur uthti hawa (low pressure); poles par tirchhi kamzor dhoop aur baithti hawa (high pressure).

book_ref.quote: the poles get slanted, weaker sunlight, leading to cold, sinking air and high-pressure zones

rows: Seedhi, tez dhoop milti hai.
Tirchhi (oblique), kamzor dhoop milti hai.
Garam hawa uthti hai.
Thandi hawa baithti hai.
Low-pressure zones bante hain.
High-pressure zones bante hain.

blocks.prompt:
65 What is the effect of the energy imbalance between the equator and the poles?
(Equator aur poles ke darmiyan energy ke adm-e-tawazun ka kya asar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh global atmospheric circulation chalata hai aur equator ke qareeb trade winds, darmiyani latitudes mein westerlies aur poles ke qareeb polar easterlies banata hai. Yeh hawaein ocean currents ke saath heat duniya bhar mein phailati hain.

book_ref.quote: This energy imbalance drives global atmospheric circulation

blocks.prompt:
66 Define specific angular momentum of an air mass and write its formula.
(Hawa ke mass ke specific angular momentum ki definition aur formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Specific angular momentum Earth ke rotation axis ke gird fi unit mass angular momentum hai: L = mvr/m = rv, jahan r axis se faasla aur v velocity hai.

book_ref.quote: we usually consider specific angular momentum, which is the angular momentum per unit mass

blocks.prompt:
67 Air with speed 300 m s⁻¹ at 5.0 × 10⁶ m from the Earth's axis moves to 3.0 × 10⁶ m from the axis keeping rv constant. Find its new speed.
(Earth ke axis se 5.0 × 10⁶ m par 300 m s⁻¹ speed wali hawa rv constant rakhte hue axis se 3.0 × 10⁶ m par aati hai. Nayi speed nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: As the air mass moves, r decreases and so v increases to keep rv constant

blocks.prompt:
68 What is the Coriolis effect? In which direction does it deflect moving air in each hemisphere?
(Coriolis effect kya hai? Har hemisphere mein yeh harkat karti hawa ko kis taraf morta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh Earth ki gardish ki wajah se harkat karti hawa ka zahiri murna hai. Northern hemisphere mein hawa daayen aur southern mein baayen murti hai. Yeh raasta badalta hai, speed nahi.

book_ref.quote: this type of effect is called Coriolis Effect

blocks.prompt:
69 Why does air moving from the equator towards a pole get deflected eastward?
(Equator se pole ki taraf jati hawa mashriq ki taraf kyun murti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka specific angular momentum rv constant rehta hai. Pole ki taraf jate hue r kam hota hai to v barhti hai. Oonche latitude par zameen ahista ghoomti hai, is liye yeh hawa zameen se aage nikal kar mashriq ki taraf (northern hemisphere mein daayen) murti hai.

book_ref.quote: It is air moving from a pole toward the equator that lags behind the faster-moving surface

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction yaad rakhein: kitaab likhti hai ke equator se pole jati hawa 'peeche reh jati hai'. Asal mein rv constant hone se is ki speed barhti hai aur yeh zameen se aage nikalti hai. Pole se equator ki taraf aane wali hawa (jis ka r barhta hai) tez ghoomti zameen se peeche reh jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
70 Name the three atmospheric circulation cells. How are they formed?
(Teen atmospheric circulation cells ke naam batayein. Yeh kaise bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hadley cell, Ferrel cell aur Polar cell (har hemisphere mein). Coriolis effect harkat karti hawa ko khamdar raaston par morta hai; yahi mure hue bahao teen cells banate hain.

book_ref.quote: the Hadley cell, Ferrel cell, and Polar cell

blocks.text: 21.13 Role of Salt and Density in Ocean Circulation

blocks.prompt:
71 Define salinity. Why does higher salinity make seawater denser?
(Salinity ki definition likhein. Zyada salinity samandari paani ko zyada ghana kyun banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Salinity samandari paani mein namak ki miqdaar hai. Hal shuda namak paani ka mass barhata hai magar volume khaas nahi barhata; density = mass/volume hai, is liye density barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: the dissolved salt increases the mass of the water without significantly increasing its volume

blocks.prompt:
72 Why do surface waters sometimes sink to deeper layers? What does this sinking produce?
(Surface ka paani kabhi kabhi gehri tahon mein kyun doob jata hai? Is doobne se kya paida hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Surface ka paani (evaporation ya samandari barf banne se) thanda aur namkeen ho kar ghana hota aur doob jata hai. Doobta paani doosre paani ko hatata hai aur duniya bhar ke samandaron mein ahista magar bari currents banti hain.

book_ref.quote: When surface waters become colder and saltier often due to evaporation or the formation of sea ice

blocks.prompt:
73 State two roles of deep ocean circulation.
(Gehri samandari gardish ke do kirdar batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Yeh heat aur gases jaise oxygen aur carbon dioxide duniya bhar mein le jati hai. (2) Surface aur gehre paani ke nizaam ko jorti hai aur Earth ke climate ko mutawazin rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: This deep circulation helps transport heat, and gases (such as oxygen and carbon dioxide)

blocks.prompt:
74 Why is thermohaline circulation called the global conveyor belt?
(Thermohaline circulation ko global conveyor belt kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Conveyor belt ki tarah yeh paani ko musalsal duniya bhar mein ghumati hai: garam surface ka paani poles ki taraf jata, thanda ho kar doobta, gehrai mein wapas aata aur kahin aur oopar uthta hai, aur taqreeban 1,000 saal mein tamam samandari basins mein heat aur ghiza (nutrients) le jata hai.

book_ref.quote: often referred to as the global conveyor belt

blocks.prompt:
75 Why does water sink in the polar regions in thermohaline circulation?
(Thermohaline circulation mein polar ilaqon mein paani kyun doobta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polar ilaqon mein paani thanda hota hai aur samandari barf banne se salinity barhti hai. Kam temperature aur zyada salinity se paani ghana ho kar doobta hai aur gehrai mein equator ki taraf wapas behta hai.

book_ref.quote: increased salinity from sea ice formation, causing it to sink

blocks.prompt:
76 Give two effects of thermohaline circulation on the Earth.
(Thermohaline circulation ke Earth par do asraat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Yeh tropics se poles tak heat le jati hai, Earth ke climate ko mutawazin rakhti aur atmosphere ke patterns par asar dalti hai. (2) Heat aur nutrients (ghiza) duniya bhar mein phaila kar samandari ecosystems ko sahara deti hai.

book_ref.quote: supports marine ecosystems by redistributing heat and nutrients globally
